summary: Resolves a camera-mode state value with fallback: reads the primary value from this+0xC; when zero, reads a fallback value from offset 52 of the sub-object pointed to by this+0x18. Returns 3 when both are zero, 1 when the resolved value is 1, (dword_7CFCC8 == 0) when the resolved value is 2, and 0 otherwise. Called from CameraTargetUpdateOnPlayerChange (0x0040C7A0) and SetDriverVisibility (0x004C7AA0).

operations.description: Read the primary camera-mode state value from this+0xC.
When the primary value is zero, fall back to the sub-object state value read from offset 52 of *(this+0x18).
Return 3 when the fallback value is also zero.
Compute v2 = v1 - 1, mapping a resolved value of 1 to 0 and a resolved value of 2 to 1.
Return 1 when the resolved value is 1.
Return (dword_7CFCC8 == 0) when the resolved value is 2, i.e. the queue-dependent flag decides the result.
Return 0 for any resolved value other than 1 or 2.

unresolved: The field at this+0x4C is recorded as a struct field but is not accessed by this function.
The exact meaning of the returned code (3, 1, queue-dependent boolean, 0) depends on the camera-mode state convention of the callers.
